text: dsh-kimicode-swarm（DSH 网页插件）：在聊天中把一批相互独立的工作交给多个子 Agent 并行处理。它提供 swarm_batch 工具和 /swarm 模式命令，并在聊天内展示子任务进度与结果。用户可以为子任务选择模型，配置类型到模型的映射，并在设置页调整超时和并发上限；任务遇到限流时会退避重试。适合需要拆分为多个独立子任务的批量研究、代码审阅或内容生成。需要 DSH web 层及 subagent 服务，无需额外 API 密钥配置。

dsh-kimicode-swarm runs independent tasks with parallel subagents in DSH. Use swarm_batch to dispatch work and /swarm to enable the mode. A chat panel shows progress and results; settings provide model mapping and concurrency limits. It suits batch research or code review and requires DSH web.

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Introduction：

dsh-kimicode-swarm — DeepSeek Harness 批量并行子 Agent 调度
dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Introduction：

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Introduction：

English · 简体中文

--- 把 **Kimi Code 的 Agent Swarm** 带进 DeepSeek Harness：你开启 Swarm 模式，主 Agent 把工作拆成互不依赖的子任务，一次派发最多 128 个子 Agent 并行执行，完成后汇总。每个子 Agent 在做什么，聊天里实时看得见。

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · 亮点：- **按子任务分配模型**：每一项都能指定模型，把贵的模型留给难的任务。
- **限流不用人管**：自动退避，接着原来的子 Agent 继续；单任务最多重试 8 次，额度耗尽时会明确失败，不会一直挂着。
- **取消不丢活**：已完成的结果模型下一轮还能看到，未完成的可按 `agent_id` 带历史续做。
- **费用你说了算**：默认只有你开启 Swarm 模式后才能派发，Agent 不能自己一次开上百个子 Agent。
- **原生界面**：分段进度条、工具活动、限流倒计时、一键进入子会话、Markdown 结果，中英文和深浅主题都跟随 DSH。
- **带上下文派发**：`fork: true` 让子 Agent 继承当前对话历史。
- **零运行时依赖**：所有依赖都由宿主提供。

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · 有多快：每个任务时长固定、互相独立时，调度层相比串行的提速：

| 任务 | 宿主并发上限 | 串行 | Swarm | 提速 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 128 个，每个 5 分钟 | 128 | 38400 秒 | 386 秒 | **99.5 倍** |
| 128 个，每个 60 秒 | 128 | 7680 秒 | 146 秒 | 52.6 倍 |
| 20 个，每个 60 秒 | 128 | 1200 秒 | 71 秒 | 17 倍 |
| 128 个，每个 60 秒 | 8（默认） | 7680 秒 | 965 秒 | 8 倍 |

这是虚拟时钟下的调度模拟，用 `pnpm bench` 可以复现。它不含模型限流，也不代表 token 费用，实际速度取决于任务和服务商。**默认上限下最多提速 8 倍**，要跑得更快需要调大 `maxActiveSubagents`（见[配置](#配置)）。并行同样会消耗更多 token。

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · 快速开始：已在 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.5** 上验证。DSH 的插件接口还在快速变化，其他版本未经测试；0.2.0 之前的版本不支持 0.2.1。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/hongyue0721/dsh-kimicode-swarm/releases/latest/download/dsh-kimicode-swarm.tgz
```

这条命令从 [GitHub Release](https://github.com/hongyue0721/dsh-kimicode-swarm/releases/latest) 安装最新版。npm 上的 `dsh-kimicode-swarm` 目前还是不兼容的 0.1.2，请先不要按包名安装。

重启 `dsh web`，在新会话里试试：

```text
/swarm 审查 src/ 下每个模块，分别给出修复建议
```

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Swarm 模式：| 命令 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/swarm` | 切换模式 |
| `/swarm on` / `/swarm off` | 持续开启 / 关闭，模式随会话保存 |
| `/swarm <任务>` | 只为这个任务开启，回合结束自动退出 |

模式开启时输入区会显示 Swarm 徽标，点一下就能关。子 Agent 不能再嵌套派发。

子 Agent 不能申请额外审批（DSH 固定其审批策略为 `never`）：超出委派权限的操作会被直接拒绝，交回父 Agent 处理，批次不会停下来等待。插件不会修改你的权限模式。

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · 指定模型：优先级从高到低：单项或整批的 `model` > 配置页的映射表 > 继承调用者的模型。

```json
{ "item": "src/core/scheduler.ts", "model": "deepseek-v4-pro" }
```

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · `swarm_batch` 参数：| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `description` | 整个 swarm 的简短描述 |
| `prompt_template` | 含 `{{item}}` 占位符的提示词模板，提供 `items` 时必填 |
| `items` | 2 到 128 项（提供 `resume_agent_ids` 时可少于 2 项），`string` 或 `{ item, model?, type? }` |
| `model` | 整批模型，优先于映射表 |
| `subagent_type` | 先匹配已注册的 Agent 预设，再匹配映射表标签，都不匹配时报错；省略则继承父 Agent |
| `fork` | 继承截至上一回合的对话历史，不能与 `resume_agent_ids`、`model`、`type`、`subagent_type` 同用 |
| `resume_agent_ids` | `agent_id -> prompt` 映射，接着已有子 Agent 继续，先于新任务启动 |
dsh-kimicode-swarm README · `swarm_batch` 参数：`fork` 适合需要上下文的子任务，但每个子 Agent 都带着完整历史，token 消耗更高。

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · 配置：模型映射、超时和并发可以在 Web 界面的「插件 → dsh-kimicode-swarm」页面修改，下一次派发立即生效。配置保存在 profile 条目中（`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-kimicode-swarm
  name: dsh-kimicode-swarm
  config:
    requireSwarmMode: true      # false 时 Agent 可以自行调用

`enabled` 和 `announceToAgent`（默认都是 `true`）在挂载时读取，只能在这个条目里改，改完插件会重新挂载。

**想跑得更快？** 宿主默认最多同时运行 8 个子 Agent，超出的任务会排队。要提高并发，在 DSH 的「子智能体」设置页调大这个上限，或者写进 profile 的 `subagent` 条目：

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · 配置：```yaml
- id: subagent
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent'
  config:
    maxActiveSubagents: 32

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · 已知限制：- **需要 Web 层**：插件依赖 `webServer` 服务，在没有 web 层的 profile（如 `tui`、`headless`）中不会激活。
- **进度通道不是认证边界**：`/swarm-events` 会拒绝跨站请求，但同源客户端能收到所有会话的进度，再由界面过滤。默认只监听本机；用 `--host` 开放到局域网前请注意。
- **没有 token 级进度**：进度展示状态、工具调用次数和最近的工具名。
- **刷新后取消结果只剩文本**：已取消的批次刷新页面后不再显示状态行，结果文本仍在。
- **没有文件锁**：多个子 Agent 的写冲突靠任务拆分规避，与 Kimi Code 相同。

更多见 [docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md)。

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · 开发：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test        # 159 个用例
pnpm build       # 产物在 lib/

设计细节和与 Kimi Code 的对照见 [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)。调度算法参考了 [Kimi Code](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code)（MIT）。

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Introduction：

dsh-kimicode-swarm — batch parallel subagent scheduling for DeepSeek Harness
dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Introduction：

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Introduction：

English · 简体中文

--- Brings **Kimi Code's Agent Swarm** to DeepSeek Harness. Turn on Swarm mode and the main agent splits the work into independent subtasks, dispatches up to 128 subagents in parallel, and merges the results. You can watch what each subagent is doing, live, right in the chat.
dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Introduction：

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Highlights：- **A model per subtask**: any item can name its own model, so the expensive one goes to the hard tasks.
- **Rate limits handle themselves**: automatic backoff that continues the same subagent, at most 8 retries per task. An exhausted quota fails clearly instead of hanging.
- **Cancelling keeps the work**: finished results stay visible to the model on its next turn, and unfinished subagents resume by `agent_id` with their history.
- **You control the bill**: by default nothing dispatches until you turn Swarm mode on, so an agent can't start a hundred subagents by itself.
- **Native UI**: segmented progress, tool activity, rate-limit countdowns, one click into a child session and Markdown results, following DSH's language and light or dark theme.
- **Dispatch with context**: `fork: true` starts subagents with the current conversation history.
- **No runtime dependencies**: everything it needs comes from the host.

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · How fast：Scheduling speedup over running one at a time, for independent tasks of a fixed duration:

| Tasks | Host concurrency limit | Serial | Swarm | Speedup |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 128, 5 minutes each | 128 | 38400 s | 386 s | **99.5x** |
| 128, 60 seconds each | 128 | 7680 s | 146 s | 52.6x |
| 20, 60 seconds each | 128 | 1200 s | 71 s | 17x |
| 128, 60 seconds each | 8 (default) | 7680 s | 965 s | 8x |

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · How fast：This is a scheduling simulation on a virtual clock, and `pnpm bench` reproduces it. It excludes provider rate limits and says nothing about token cost; real speed depends on your tasks and provider. **The default limit caps the speedup at 8x.** Going faster means raising `maxActiveSubagents` (see [Configuration](#configuration)). Parallel work also uses more tokens.

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Quick start：Verified on DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.5**. DSH's plugin APIs are still moving quickly, so other versions are untested. Versions of this plugin before 0.2.0 do not support DSH 0.2.1.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/hongyue0721/dsh-kimicode-swarm/releases/latest/download/dsh-kimicode-swarm.tgz
```

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Quick start：This installs the latest version from the [GitHub Release](https://github.com/hongyue0721/dsh-kimicode-swarm/releases/latest). The `dsh-kimicode-swarm` package on npm is still the incompatible 0.1.2, so don't install by package name for now.

Restart `dsh web` and try this in a new session:

```text
/swarm Review each module under src/ and suggest fixes for each
```

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Swarm mode：| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/swarm` | Toggle the mode |
| `/swarm on` / `/swarm off` | Keep it on or turn it off; the mode is saved with the session |
| `/swarm <task>` | On for this task only; it ends with the turn |

While the mode is on, a Swarm badge appears in the input area, and clicking it turns the mode off. Subagents cannot dispatch further swarms.

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Swarm mode：Subagents cannot request extra approval (DSH pins their approval policy to `never`). Operations beyond their delegated permissions are rejected and left to the parent agent, so a batch never stops to wait for approval. The plugin does not change your permission mode.

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Choosing models：From highest priority to lowest: `model` on an item or the batch, then the mapping table on the settings page, then the caller's model.

```json
{ "item": "src/core/scheduler.ts", "model": "deepseek-v4-pro" }
```

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · `swarm_batch` parameters：| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `description` | Short description of the whole swarm |
| `prompt_template` | Prompt with a `{{item}}` placeholder; required with `items` |
| `items` | 2 to 128 entries (fewer with `resume_agent_ids`), each a `string` or `{ item, model?, type? }` |
| `model` | Model for the whole batch; overrides the mapping table |
| `subagent_type` | Matches a registered agent preset, then a mapping-table label, and errors if neither matches; omit it to inherit from the parent |
| `fork` | Inherit the conversation up to the last completed turn; cannot combine with `resume_agent_ids`, `model`, `type` or `subagent_type` |
| `resume_agent_ids` | Map of `agent_id` to prompt that continues existing subagents, started before new tasks |
dsh-kimicode-swarm README · `swarm_batch` parameters：`fork` suits subtasks that need context, but every subagent carries the full history, so it costs more tokens.

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Configuration：Model mapping, timeout and concurrency can be edited in the web UI under Plugins → dsh-kimicode-swarm, and apply to the next dispatch. They are stored with the profile entry (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: dsh-kimicode-swarm
  name: dsh-kimicode-swarm
  config:
    requireSwarmMode: true      # false lets the agent call it by itself

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Configuration：`enabled` and `announceToAgent` (both `true` by default) are read when the plugin mounts. They can only be changed in this entry, which remounts the plugin.

**Want it faster?** The host runs at most 8 subagents at once and queues the rest. To raise that, use DSH's subagent settings page or set `maxActiveSubagents` on the profile's `subagent` entry:

```yaml
- id: subagent
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent'
  config:
    maxActiveSubagents: 32

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Known limitations：- **Needs the web layer**: the plugin depends on the `webServer` service, so it does not activate in profiles without one, such as `tui` and `headless`.
- **The progress channel is not an auth boundary**: `/swarm-events` rejects cross-site requests, but a same-origin client receives progress for every session and the UI filters it. It listens on localhost by default; take care before exposing it with `--host`.
- **No token-level progress**: progress shows status, tool call count and the latest tool name.
- **A cancelled batch shows text after a refresh**: its status rows are gone after reloading the page, while the result text remains.
- **No file locking**: write conflicts between subagents are avoided by how tasks are split, same as Kimi Code.
dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Known limitations：See [docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md) for more.

dsh-kimicode-swarm README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test        # 159 tests
pnpm build       # output in lib/

Design details and the comparison with Kimi Code are in [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md). The scheduling algorithm draws on [Kimi Code](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code) (MIT).
